items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: we're going to take Freddie Kepert's place, Mabel, Elaine and the New Orleans Jazz Band... The first time the first bunch went away was Freddie, George Dibacque, Jimmy Pollard... Then I, then I left and I was taking the group. I was taking Sugar Johnny... Lewis Kepert, guitar. Myself on bass.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . and this band comes to me and wants a band to go to Chicago and we're going to travel. We're going to take Freddie Kepert's place, Mabel, Elaine and the New Orleans Jazz Band.
